Subject: Fraudulent withdrawals from the Accounts of EPFO through fake cheques-
instructions to avoid fraudulent payment- reg.

Sir,

‘ Instances of encashment of fake cheques from EPF Account No. I and X have been reported
by some of the field offices. Instructions were issued earlier vide this office circular letter No.
Bkg/1(5)/2006/Bank Agreement/Part/ 27794 dated 19/09/2011 posted at SI. No. 304 of the official
website of the organization under Office Orders & Circulars issued during 2011-2012 to take
precautionary measures to avoid such fraudulent payments.

2 It is observed that inspite of instructions issued by Head Office, this problem still persists.
This matter has been examined in Head Office and following instructions are issued.

i) Immediately bank statements of EPF Account No. I & X_ be analysed and all
amounts debited therein for more than Rs. one lakh should be verified from the cash
books. This exercise should be from 1* April, 2011 onwards and if any discrepancy
is found therein, action with the Bank Authorities and to file FIR be taken wherever
required. The same should be intimated to Head Office by name to RPFC-I (F&A) by
30-11-2011.

ii) Cash Books of all the accounts should be reconciled upto date and a certificate by
the Officer-in-charge of the offices stating that cash books of all five accounts
(1,I1,X,XXI and XXII) have been reconciled upto 31% October, 2011 should reach to
Head Office by name to RPFC-I(F&A) by 15-12-2011.

iii) All debits/payments made by Bank from Account No. I, X and XXI for more than
Rupees One Lakh be verified from cash books on daily basis and in case of any
variation observed, action should be taken immediately with the bank authorities and
Police Authorities wherever required.

All payments to the beneficiaries from Account No. I, X and XXI be made through
NEFT/RTGS only. However, in order to avoid any inconvenience to the beneficiaries
entitled to small amounts from EPF Organisation, payment to them through cheques
can be made upto Rs.10,000/-. Under no circumstances, cheques beyond
Rs.10,000/- be issued from A/c No. 1,10 & 21.

All payments on account of Pension to other Banks, all inter-regional transfers and
transfers from EPFO to Exempted Trusts shall be made through NEFT/RTGS only.

Instructions at point No.(iv) above be brought to the notice of link branch of State
Bank of India attached to your office for implementation. The bank should be
informed by you that no cheques beyond Rs.10,000/- be cleared from Account No. I,
X and XXI from now onwards. However, the cheques already issued upto 22-11-
2011 amounting to more than Rs.10,000/- will be cleared by State Bank of India, the
same should be accordingly taken care of.

The cheque Sr. No. of Account No. I, X and XXI which have not yet been issued upto
21-11-2011 be also intimated to State Bank of India Link Branch of your office
stating that these cheqeus should not be cleared by the Bank for more that
Rs.10,000/- and in case any cheque from these Sr. Nos. is presented for payment
for more that Rs.10,000/-, the same should not be paid and the matter be reported
to your office immediately. You may take action in case of such incidents is reported.

Above instructions shall be followed scrupulously without any deviation.

( This issues with the approval of CPFC ).

Yours faithfully,
